column5: {candidate} run-cache key binds the -c object source argv spelling (srcraw): an absolute source in two dirs sharing a cache no longer reuses the first dir's object. Precise pinning (0.0.105): comment/string-literal __FILE__ does not pin; a real __FILE__, CAT(__FI,LE__) fragment, -DW=__FILE__, cross-file CAT, or header __FILE__ does; an unterminated literal falls back to a whole-file substring (over-pin, never under-pin); pin assertions run on the -run route so srcraw cannot mask them. A header gaining __FILE__ no longer leaves the unit permanently cold (both pin keys are tried). Six object/invariant checks, three negative controls (source/argv/header) that must miss. 21 assertions.
